headline: Volume and price lift growth; full-year outlook raised
summary_short: Revenue rose 9.6% y/y to $1,172.6M (7.2% organic) and diluted EPS reached $2.59, up 18.8%; the company raised its full-year revenue and adjusted EPS outlook.
summary_long: Growth was led by the Americas, where revenue rose 11.7% on volume and price, with non-residential up low-double digits organically. International was down 0.2% organically. Adjusted operating margin was 24.7% versus 24.1%. Results include $19.9M of tariff-refund benefit to operating income, excluded from adjusted figures. The company repurchased about $120M of stock. Full-year adjusted EPS outlook is now $9.05-$9.10.
confidence_notes: Reported EPS and operating income include a $19.9M IEEPA tariff-refund benefit to operating income plus $0.9M of interest income; adjusted measures exclude these.

drivers.explanation: Organic growth of 7.2% came from volume growth and price realization, led by the Americas; acquisitions added 2.6% net.
Adjusted margin gains are attributed to favorable volume leverage plus price and productivity net of inflation and investment.
Reported operating income also includes a $19.9 million benefit from IEEPA tariff refunds.
CEO cites steady momentum in demand generation and a resilient business model as reasons for raising the full-year outlook.
